title: Heaven Apostles
subtitle: Any exciting adventure needs at least one explosion.

trails.title: How Many Older Sisters Does Schneider Have?
trails.description: Schneider's parents are still alive and have raised many daughters. How many older sisters does she have?

content.text: Schneider's parents are still alive and have raised many daughters. How many older sisters does she have?

trails.title: Trail ① Garden Scissors
trails.description: A pair of sharp garden scissors which can cut off thorns and vines easily.

items.text: Heaven Apostles

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Not so many forks ahead! We are getting closer to the outer wall.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. I heard the sounds of the street.

items.speaker: Bodyguards
items.text: Miss Sotheby, did you get hurt? We didn't know there were so many ambushes ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: No worries! You carry Freddy ... ahem ... and clean up the potion on his mouth!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We gathered much intelligence this time. When we get out of here, I will write a report ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Oh, and ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, there is another person!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I heard someone asking for help around here! There was also remnants of potion there ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I want to help her get out.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Can you find her position?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let me think ... it should be around the wall, in front of the critter lair ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: At the end of this corner ... turn right ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh! Sis, it's Schneider, call my name …

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't you remember me? It's Schneider ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Oh, sorry …

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: I'll get you out right now ... Back to our citrus orchard in Sicily …

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: *vomits*

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Shh ... be quiet! We will be back home soon.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You chased us here!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It is you! You are abusing this girl ... evil murderer, I must stop you!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't piss me off. Get lost!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Sonetto's arcane skill rushes toward Schneider. Unlike what she used to cast, this one is like a blade made of anger.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Uggh …

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: The girl falls down from Schneider's back. She opens her eyes and rushes to Vertin in panic.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: No! No! I'm not arcanist! I'm not arcanist! I'm not arcanist!!

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: I didn’t ... won't pretend to be an arcanist ... Oh ... I-I-I can't ... can't drink anymore ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're here to help. Stay calm, miss.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: She seems to have lost her mind: despite what others say, she just keeps repeating the same incomprehensible words, hands grasping the one in front of her.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Uggh ... Let go ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Sis ... don't be like this. You are safe now.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: What the hell did they force you to eat! F**k!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You are her sister ... I ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She took the Truth Serum. I have memorized the formula. The feel and smell of the liquid could confirm it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let her lie on her back. Right arm high. I will conduct first aid and get her vomit up the potion.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: ... Ok. Be quick.
The coming sound of footsteps seems more and more oppressive to those who are stranded by this labyrinth.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Woosh! Woosh!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: The whipping sound of vines echoes in the corridor.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It is followed by countless footsteps, which implies danger that approaches like a swarm of greedy insects.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh! We got company! We need to get out of here fast!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Schneider stands up.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Stay focused. Forget the rest.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Just a little more time, she will spit it out ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Woosh! Woosh! Woosh!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Someone walks toward them leisurely out of the dark.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Her arcane skill has destroyed every inch of the corridor as she approaches.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Waffles, the new enemies are not something we can deal with!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Everyone, I found the exit!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: This is where we crashed into! As long as we push out the "Auto Island", we can escape from here!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Everyone, start pushing now! We have to get out of here!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Waffles, the new enemies are not something we can deal with!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: As the enemy approaches from the distance, a group of men in black rush out from another corner.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: They look around, panic-stricken, and eventually their eyes fall on Schneider.

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: Is it here? Is the exit here?

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: Boss! What should we do?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Here you are ... The exit is here.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Push the car!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: New guys push the hood! Keep pushing! On my mark!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Ready? Push! Ready? Push!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ... I'm sorry. My "Auto Island" is too strong ... Umm, it's ... it's not moving at all …

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I'm running out of strength …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mr. APPLe! The "Heaven Apostle"!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Please move out of the way! This is very dangerous!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Three rounds left, then right, open the wing, put on the wheel ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Stay away from the car!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ... wow!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The car is blasted to the street! Get out of the hole while you can! This wall is about to collapse!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Run ... I can hold a little longer ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Four. Five. Six. Quick! We're all out! Just you!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper! The wall is falling down!
... Sorry. Please, don't run away.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the blink of an eye, she is now standing in front of them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Judging from her speed of approaching and the range of her arcane skill, it won't make any difference even if all of them manage to escape from the bar.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Only four are left inside the wall.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto is trying hard to maintain balance at the exit while carrying Marian on her back.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper ... Timekeeper!

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: You are ... Schneider, right? Did I ... get away?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Yes. You made it.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: You are free now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Go. Run freely.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Leave the rest to me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Vertin and Schneider gently push them out of the exit.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The next moment, the wall has collapsed, blocking the only way out.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Heh heh ... surprisingly, there's a day ... to fight side by side with you, Ms. Governor.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let's see what a good match we are.
We win, or we die!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's win or die.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... It's you?
TO BE CONTINUED…
